sources.title: Brand, White, Rogers & Webster. 2022. Estimating bonobo (Pan paniscus) and chimpanzee (Pan troglodytes) evolutionary history from nucleotide site patterns. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 119(17):e2200858119
sources.locator: Abstract; Methods, “Genomic Data”; Results, “Introgression from Western into Eastern Chimpanzees”; Table 1 and Figure 4.
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), as stated by the article.
sources.scope: Site-pattern analysis of whole-genome data from all five extant Pan lineages; model-based deep population history, not a species-wide census or consensus phylogeny.

claims.text: Brand et al. analyzed whole-genome site patterns from 18 central, 19 eastern, 10 Nigeria–Cameroon, and 11 western chimpanzees, alongside bonobos. Their best-fitting model estimated western-to-eastern chimpanzee introgression and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago; the authors identify the estimate as model-based and discuss competing histories.
claims.textZh: Brand 等人分析了 18 只中部、19 只东部、10 只尼日利亚—喀麦隆和 11 只西部黑猩猩的全基因组位点模式，并纳入倭黑猩猩。拟合最佳的模型估计了西部向东部黑猩猩的基因渗入，并将四个受采样黑猩猩谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前；作者说明这是模型估计，并讨论了其他历史模型。
claims.locator: Methods, “Genomic Data”; Abstract; Results, “Introgression from Western into Eastern Chimpanzees”; Table 1.
claims.placeTimeScope: Whole-genome samples from the five extant Pan lineages; dates and introgression proportions are demographic-model estimates with uncertainty, not directly dated specimens.
claims.lifeStatus: Wild chimpanzee and bonobo genomic samples; no captive or fossil samples in the focal analysis.

gaps: This is one model-comparison study. Its lineage history has not been reconciled here with later genome-wide analyses, fossil evidence, or every chimpanzee population; no general phylogenetic placement or trait-evolution synthesis is claimed.

reasons: Only one model-based evolutionary study was assessed; six facets remain not-assessed and the evolution facet is partial.
No systematic literature search or global evidence synthesis has been completed.

sources.title: Robbins, Ortmann & Seiler. 2022. Dietary variability of western gorillas (Gorilla gorilla gorilla). PLOS ONE 17(8):e0271576
sources.version: Published 2022-08-24; PLOS ONE volume 17, issue 8; DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0271576
sources.locator: Abstract; Methods, “Study site and data collection”; Results, “Dietary composition”; Table 1 and Figure 2.
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), as stated by the article.
sources.scope: Ten gorillas in the Atananga Group, Loango National Park, Gabon, observed January 2018–July 2020; comparisons are bounded to three western gorilla study sites.

claims.text: Across the Loango, Bai Hokou, and Mondika study sites, Robbins et al. report that western gorillas spent roughly half of feeding time on herbaceous vegetation and tree leaves and about 35% on fruit. At Loango, nuts accounted for about 10% of feeding time; insects were recorded at the other two sites instead. The study documents site variation and does not estimate a range-wide species average.
claims.textZh: Robbins 等人报告，在 Loango、Bai Hokou 和 Mondika 研究点，西部大猩猩约一半的取食时间用于草本植物和树叶，约 35% 用于果实。在 Loango，坚果约占取食时间的 10%；另外两个地点则记录到昆虫。该研究展示了地点间差异，并未估算全分布区的物种平均值。
claims.placeTimeScope: Three western gorilla field sites in Gabon, Central African Republic, and Republic of the Congo; Loango observations covered January 2018–July 2020. Percentages refer to feeding time in the study samples.
claims.lifeStatus: Wild western lowland gorillas; one habituated Loango group and published comparisons at Bai Hokou and Mondika.

gaps: Site and group samples do not establish a range-wide diet, season-by-season variation, or all ecological interactions for COL usage 3H3C9.

reasons: Only one bounded ecological study was assessed; six facets remain not-assessed and ecology is partial.
No systematic literature search, range-wide ecological synthesis, or global conservation assessment has been completed.

sources.title: Hardus et al. 2012. Behavioral, Ecological, and Evolutionary Aspects of Meat-Eating by Sumatran Orangutans (Pongo abelii). International Journal of Primatology 33(2):287–304
sources.version: Published online 2012-01-07; journal volume 33, issue 2; DOI 10.1007/s10764-011-9574-z
sources.locator: Abstract; Methods, “Study site and subjects”; Results, “Meat-eating”; Table I and Figure 1.
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 2.0 (CC BY-NC 2.0), as stated by Springer Nature.
sources.scope: Three observations involving one adult female and her dependent offspring at Ketambe, Gunung Leuser National Park, Sumatra, in February and December 2007 and April 2008; prior cases are separately identified by the authors.

claims.text: Hardus et al. report three slow-loris meat-eating events involving one adult female and her dependent female offspring at Ketambe. During the observed cases, the mother often rejected the offspring’s meat-sharing requests and the offspring initiated sharing; the observations describe one dyad, not a population-wide mother–offspring pattern.
claims.textZh: Hardus 等人报告，在 Ketambe 观察到一只成年雌性及其依赖型雌性后代三次捕食懒猴的事件。观察期间，母亲经常拒绝后代分享肉食的请求，而后代会发起分享；这些记录仅描述一个母女配对，不能代表整个种群的母子互动模式。
claims.locator: Abstract; Methods, “Study site and subjects”; Results, “Meat-eating and meat sharing”; Table I.
claims.placeTimeScope: Ketambe Research Station, Gunung Leuser National Park, Sumatra, Indonesia; three events in February 2007, December 2007, and April 2008; one observed mother–dependent-offspring dyad.
claims.lifeStatus: Free-ranging wild adult female and dependent female offspring; the offspring was 6–7 years old and not fully weaned.

gaps: Three observations from one dyad cannot establish typical reproductive, developmental, or parental behavior across Pongo abelii; broader life-history evidence has not been assessed.

claims.text: The authors report that slow-loris captures in their combined observations occurred only when ripe-fruit availability was low, and propose meat as a possible fallback food. The new cases came from one Ketambe dyad; the proposed seasonal relationship is an inference from a small case set.
claims.textZh: 作者报告，其汇总的观察中懒猴捕食事件仅发生在成熟果实可得性较低时，并提出肉食可能是备用食物。新观察来自 Ketambe 的一个母女配对；季节关系是基于少量案例提出的推断。
claims.locator: Abstract; Results, “Seasonality of slow loris meat-eating”; Figure 2.
claims.placeTimeScope: Ketambe, Sumatra; new observations in 2007–2008 combined with earlier published cases from Ketambe and Suaq Balimbing; not a range-wide diet study.
claims.lifeStatus: Wild orangutan observations; no captive feeding evidence is included.

gaps: The small, opportunistic event set does not establish prevalence, a causal fruit-availability effect, or the species’ overall diet and ecological interactions.

reasons: Only one small field study was assessed; five facets remain not-assessed and life history and ecology are partial.
No systematic literature search, broad behavioral synthesis, or global range and conservation assessment has been completed.
